program:
PARAMS = {
    "I":      (0.5e-6, 0.25e-6, 0.9e-6),   # branch current
    "gmid_n": (20.0, 14.0, 24.0),          # NMOS pair in weak inversion -> PTAT
    "gmid_p": (13.0, 8.0, 15.0),
    "L":      (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),             # long L: mirror accuracy / line regulation
    "K":      (8.0, 4.0, 16.0),            # beta-multiplier width ratio
    "kptat":  (1.0, 0.7, 1.3),             # trims PTAT drop R2*I (TC knob)
    "f":      (0.3, 0.15, 0.45),           # fraction of output current taken by divider
    "vtgt":   (0.77, 0.65, 0.88),          # target vref (divider tap)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = p["I"]; L = p["L"]; K = max(2, int(round(p["K"])))
    # --- beta-multiplier core ---
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], L, I, vds=0.6)
    W2 = K * m1.W
    vs = 0.07
    for _ in range(8):                       # self-consistent source voltage of M2 (with body effect)
        lo, hi = 0.0, 1.4
        for _ in range(40):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            if lut.op("n", W2, L, mid, 0.5, vsb=vs)["Id"] > I:
                hi = mid
            else:
                lo = mid
        vgs2 = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        vs = max(m1.vgs - vgs2, 0.01)
    Rs = vs / I
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], L, I, vds=0.6)

    # --- output branch: PTAT current into R2 + Q3, divider scales the bandgap ---
    f = p["f"]
    IQ = (1 - f) * I
    veb = 0.76 - UT * math.log(10e-6 / IQ)
    R2 = p["kptat"] * (1.22 - veb) / IQ          # IQ*R2 ~ Vg0-Veb  -> zero TC at X
    vbg = veb + IQ * R2
    X = vbg                                       # node X ~ Veb + IQ*R2
    Rd = X / (f * I)
    ratio = min(max(p["vtgt"] / X, 0.3), 0.95)
    Rd2 = ratio * Rd; Rd1 = Rd - Rd2

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # core
    n.dev("M3", "pg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)        # PMOS diode
    n.dev("M4", "ng", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M1", "ng", "ng", "vss", "vss", m1)        # NMOS diode
    n.M("M2", "pg", "ng", "sx", "vss", "nfet", W2, L)
    n.R("Rs", "sx", "vss", Rs)
    n.C("Cpg", "pg", "vdd", 0.5e-12)
    # output
    n.dev("M5", "x", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("R2", "x", "e3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=1)
    n.R("Rd1", "x", "vref", Rd1)
    n.R("Rd2", "vref", "vss", Rd2)
    # start-up: weak pull-up -> st high when core off -> Ms1 pulls pg low
    n.M("Ms2a", "s1", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20)
    n.M("Ms2b", "st", "vss", "s1", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20)
    n.M("Ms3", "st", "ng", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 10 * m1.W, L)
    n.M("Ms1", "pg", "st", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 1.0)

    vref = X * ratio
    power = 1.8 * (3 * I + 0.2e-6)
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": 400.0, "psrr_1k": 30.0,
               "line_reg": 0.02, "power": power, "startup_ok": 1}
